A black-and-withe graph without colors. Edges: black edges. Vertices: 7 nodes in total. 4 black nodes p2 (center, bottom), p3 (left, mid top), p4 (right, mid top), p1 (center), and 3 white nodes n1 (left, mid bottom), n2 (center, top), n3 (right, mid bottom). Edges are connected between n2, p4, n3, p2, n1 and p3 by straight lines to form a circle and p1 connected to all of them. Add one curved edges between p3 and n3 arcing up. Labels near each node (not in the nodes).
criteria: Black-and-white graph, no shading or color
All edges connected in exactly the same way as described, one curved edge and others straight
Node colors: p* black, n* white, all circular
Text labels positioned near (not inside) corresponding nodes

caption: An equilateral triangle graph with nodes A, B, C at vertices. Node A (top) and B (bottom-left) are green circle with "3" in it; node C (bottom-right) is a brown circle with "4" in it. Place letters A, B, C outside near each node. Connect A-C with a red edge labeled "Round 1", B-C with a blue edge labeled "Round 2", and A-B with a brown edge labeled "Round 4". Edge labels follow edge direction and color, positioned in the middle of the edges.
criteria: Three nodes form an equilateral triangle
Node A and B circles green with number 3 in it; node C circle brown with number 4 in it
Text labels A, B, C near corresponding nodes outside circles; with A top, B bottom-left, C bottom-right
Edges: A-C red, B-C blue, A-B brown, all straight lines
Edge labels: "Round 1" on A-C (red), "Round 2" on B-C (blue), "Round 4" on A-B (brown), placed in the middle of the edges

caption: A coordinate system consists of a horizontal axis with arrows at both ends and a vertical axis with only an upward-pointing arrow. Place four labeled points on the horizontal axis from left to right: x_1^+ (left to origin), x_1^- (right to origin), x_2^+ (right to origin), x_2^- (right to origin). Mark each with a small filled circle: blue for x_1^+, x_2^+, red for x_1^-, x_2^-. Draw a blue semicircle arc above the axis from x_1^+ to x_2^+, labeled γ^+ near its top, and a larger red semicircle from x_1^- to x_2^-, labeled γ^- near its top.
criteria: A coordinate system with horizontal axis with dual arrows and a vertical axis with only up arrow
Four ordered points on horizontal axis labeled x_1^+, x_1^-, x_2^+, x_2^-
Blue circles at x_1^+, x_2^+ and red circles at x_1^-, x_2^-
Blue semicircle from x_1^+ to x_2^+ and larger red semicircle from x_1^- to x_2^- above axis
Text labels γ^+ near blue arc and γ^- near red arc, not overlapping arcs

caption: A Young diagram of shape (5,4,2,1) with 12 square cells outlined in black on a white background. Row 1 contains $4, \bar{4}, \bar{3}, 2, 2$; Row 2 contains $3, 3, \bar{3}, \bar{2}$; Row 3 contains $\bar{3}, \bar{1}$; Row 4 contains $1$.
criteria: Four left-aligned rows of equal-sized squares (black outlines, white background)
Four row have lengths of 5,4,2,1 from top to down
Each square should have the right number with format in it.

caption: A 3 (height) * 5 (width) rectangular checkerboard (alternating black and white squares and the top-left square being white). Place a equal-size all-white rectangle behind it, offset down-right, labeled "R" at its lower-right edge. On the front board, place 2 * 4 light-gray filled circles centered on the internal grid intersections. Label the upper-left white square "X", the middle-left black square "Y", and the lower-left gray circle "Z" inside the square or circle.
criteria: 3*5 checkerboard with correct black-white alternation and top-left square being white
Second all-white rectangle behind, offset down-right, labeled "R" at lower-right
2*4 gray circles on grid intersections
Labels: X on upper-left white square, Y on middle-left black square, Z inside lower-left circle

caption: On the left, a small light-green circle labeled “{j}” below it. To the right, a large light-green circle with label “R” below. Overlapping its right side, a medium light-orange circle labeled “G” below. In the overlapping region, place the label “$\overline{G}$”; place label “$\underline{R}$” in the non-overlapping part of the large green circle and label “G*” in the non-overlapping part of the medium orange circle.
criteria: Three circles from left to right: small green left, large green center, medium orange right
Large green and medium orange circles overlap; left circle isolated
Labels: {j} below left green; R below middle green; G below right orange
Overlapping region labels: overlined G; Non-overlapping region labels: underlined R for green circle and G* for orange circle

caption: An undirected weighted graph. Four nodes labeled a, b, c, d form a diamond: b at top, c at bottom, a left-middle, d right-middle. Nodes a and d are filled black with white letters; b and c are white circles with black letters. Connect edges a–b, a–c, b–c, b–d, c–d with straight lines. Place edge weights 1,2,3,4,5 in the middle of the edges respectively.
criteria: Four nodes with correct labels and positions (diamond layout)
Correct fill: a,d black; b,c white
Edges correctly connected and straight
Edge weights are correct and placed in the middle pf correct edges

caption: An equilateral triangle with vertices labeled 0 (bottom left), 1 (bottom right), and 1 (top). Add a central vertex labeled 4 connected to the three vertices of the triangle. On the outer edges: the left edge (0 to top 1) has three evenly placed intermediate points labeled 2, 3, 4 from top to down; the right edge (top 1 to bottom 1) has one middle points labeled 0. On the inner edges: the edge from 4 to 0 has 3 evenly placed point labeled 3, 2, 1 from top to down; the edge from 4 to top 1 has 2 evenly placed point labeled 2, 3 from top to down; the edge from 4 to bottom 1 has one middle point labeled 0.

A central vertex labeled 4 and connected to all vertices of the triangle
Each outer edge has the correct number and labels of middle points
Each inner edge has the correct number and labels of middle points

To the right of a, a diagram (y) consists 3 rows of unit white squares of length (1,3,4) from top to down, aligned at the left. Place curly braces with labels β, α on the left of b and a, and a bottom curly brace under y labeled γ.

Left column: 2-square above 3-square, vertically aligned
Right diagram: three rows of length (1, 3, 4), left aligned
Curly braces correctly placed: left of b, left of a, and below y and labels β, α, γ correctly placed

Bottom-left 3*3 block uniformly gray, others white
Labels are correct and are in the correct places

Group 3 (right): a 1*3 row of three horizantal squares. Centered below each group, place labels from left to right: under group 1: x1 x2 x3, under group 2: x4 x5, under group 3: x6 x7 x8, evenly spaced.
criteria: Left group is a 3 (wdith) * 2 (height) rectangle of six white squares
Middle group is an L-shaped three squares
Right group is a horizontal row of three squares
Labels x1–x8 correctly grouped and centered under shapes

caption: Three circular nodes with label 1, 2, 3 inside in triangular layout (1 left-top, 2 right-top, 3 bottom). State 1, its outgoing arrows and labels are red, state 2, its outgoing arrows and labels are blue, state 3, its outgoing arrows and labels are black. Self-loops on all nodes with correct labels and color.
Correct directed edges between nodes with correct labels and color.
